title: Textbook rental and resale
summary: Rent or resell textbooks cheaply between students.
whyTempting: Textbooks are expensive and students are broke.
whyItFails: Digital shift. Publishers move to digital access codes. Seasonal and local. Demand clumps at semester start. Edition changes. Publishers kill resale value.
whatWouldChange: Largely closed by digital licensing; little upside left.

attempts.notes: Started as textbook rental, handed physical textbooks to Ingram in 2014; later hit hard by AI chatbots.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Intel for pennies on the dollar

reasons.detail: Digital shift: Publishers move to digital access codes.
Seasonal and local: Demand clumps at semester start.
Edition changes: Publishers kill resale value.
